FIX ONE FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDING ON PR #799 (validate-constraints action). Target branch codex/run-38012804725-1, expected head 46f6e6f; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/operator/actions/v3-system-search-validate-constraints.sh and tests/test_v3_system_search_validate_constraints.py may change.

FINDING (P2, ~line 332): when the detached runner stops early (statement/lock timeout or constraint violation) it writes `exit=<nonzero>` to run.log, but `status` still reports success/exit 0 because only catalog queries are checked. CHANGE: in status_operation, read the LAST line of run.log matching ^exit=[0-9]+$ (if the file exists); if the exit code is nonzero AND all_validated is false, add failure code validation_runner_failed (status stopped, exit 1) and include runner_exit_code in the receipt (null when no exit line yet, i.e. still running or never launched). A nonzero exit with all 18 validated is reported as runner_exit_code but not a failure (the catalog is the truth). Tests: nonzero exit + 17 validated → stopped/exit 1 with validation_runner_failed; nonzero exit + 18 validated → success; no exit line → runner_exit_code null and no failure.

VALIDATION: bash -n; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_system_search_validate_constraints.py -q -p no:cacheprovider; git diff --name-only 46f6e6f lists only the two files. Commit message: 'ops: validate-constraints status fails on a nonzero runner exit with checks still unvalidated'.
